definitions.full: H2943. taan I. [ טָעַן ] verb load (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic , טְעַן טְעֵן, carry , also laod ) — Qal Imperative אֶתבְּֿעִירְכֶם טַעֲנוּ Gen 45:17 (E) load your beasts.
